instruction: The init file is located at C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc. You need to open it yourself before doing the task. Warehouse Upgrade Retrofit IFC And Revit Sheet PDF This task starts from init.ifc and uses the local reference image init_sheet.png. In Revit, modify the starting model into a warehouse upgrade scheme, export the model as result.ifc, and export a one-page Revit sheet PDF as result.pdf in the Desktop. 1. The output folder contains result.ifc and result.pdf; result.ifc is at least 500 bytes and result.pdf is at least 200 bytes. 2. Result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema. 3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique. 4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 2 IfcSpace entities, 8 IfcWall entities, and 2 IfcSlab entities. 5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcDoor, 0 IfcWindow, 0 IfcStair, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcCurtainWall, and 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. 6. After replacing hyphens and underscores with spaces and lowercasing names, the IfcSpace name list contains the token warehouse at least once and area at least once. 7. Result.pdf contains exactly 1 page exported from a Revit sheet. 8. The extracted text from result.pdf contains the case-insensitive tokens WAREHOUSE UPGRADE and Principal upgrade sheet. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
